name: gato_press_action
doc: Stands in for gato_press_action.state (main checkout root): Crono talks to GATO and his song runs to its last box ('...And earn 15 Silver Points'); one more A (`100:8,0:300`) boots the battle, as from the reference. Loc 006, Crono (134,164) as the reference, Marle at (148,165) (the reference: (137,164)), 400 G, Active mode ($2990 = C4).
